<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518913794_theRebbe_460" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518913794_theRebbe_460__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section provides the opening header and date for the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">Monday of Rosh HaShanah, 5740*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section indicates the text is a discourse (hanachah).</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">– A discourse –</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the verses about trumpets and remembrance, the Gemara's derivation that Malchiyos must accompany Zichronos, and the three themes of Rosh HaShanah—Malchiyos, Zichronos, and Shofros—which are actualized through the physical act of shofar blowing, with the Rebbeim explaining the distinction between the blessings and the blasts.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"And on your day of rejoicing, and on your festivals, and on your new moons, you shall blow the trumpets... and they shall be for you a remembrance before your G-d,</t>
    <t s="1">I am the L-rd your G-d."</t>
    <t s="2">And it is brought in the Gemara:</t>
    <t s="3">"What is the purpose of the statement 'I am the L-rd your G-d'? This establishes a general principle that wherever 'remembrances' are mentioned, 'kingships' must accompany them."</t>
    <t s="4">(For "I am the L-rd your G-d" is [the theme of] Kingship,</t>
    <t s="5">and from the fact that it says "I am the L-rd your G-d" regarding "and they shall be for you a remembrance," we learn that wherever "remembrances" are mentioned, "kingships" must also be said.)</t>
    <t s="6">And from this we learn</t>
    <t s="7">that on Rosh HaShanah one must recite Malchiyos, Zichronos, and Shofros.</t>
    <t s="8">"You shall blow..." — Shofros,</t>
    <t s="9">"And they shall be for you a remembrance..." — Zichronos,</t>
    <t s="10">"I am the L-rd your G-d" — Malchiyos.</t>
    <t s="11">Now, these three matters</t>
    <t s="12">(Malchiyos, Zichronos, and Shofros)</t>
    <t s="13">are not only in speech,</t>
    <t s="14">the recitation of the verses of Malchiyos, Zichronos, and Shofros,</t>
    <t s="15">as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said:</t>
    <t s="16">"Recite before Me on Rosh HaShanah Malchiyos, Zichronos, and Shofros,"</t>
    <t s="17">but also in actual deed,</t>
    <t s="18">as is explained in the aforementioned statement of our Rabbis: "Malchiyos — so that you make Me King..."</t>
    <t s="19">(that you make Me King in actual deed)</t>
    <t s="20">"Zichronos — so that your remembrance may arise before Me"</t>
    <t s="21">(that your remembrance may arise in actual deed)</t>
    <t s="22">"And with what? With the shofar," through the actual physical act of blowing the shofar.</t>
    <t s="23">Now, the blessings</t>
    <t s="24">(the blessings of Malchiyos, Zichronos, and Shofros)</t>
    <t s="25">are mutually indispensable,</t>
    <t s="26">but the blessings and the blasts are not mutually indispensable.</t>
    <t s="27">And it is explained in the discourses of our Nesi'im on this topic</t>
    <t s="28">("And on your day of rejoicing")</t>
    <t s="29">that because the blessings and the blasts are two different matters,</t>
    <t s="30">the blessings are speech and the blasts are deed.</t>
    <t s="31">And one must understand why on Rosh HaShanah both matters are needed.</t>
    <t s="32">Especially since the simple meaning of the Sages' phrase "And with what? With the shofar" refers to the shofar blast,</t>
    <t s="33">that the matter of "make Me King over you" and "your remembrance may arise before Me for good" is accomplished through the shofar blast, which is the main thing.</t>
    <t s="34">And this is also evident from the statement of our Rabbis,</t>
    <t s="35">that "the mitzvah of the day is with the shofar," meaning that all the matters of this day</t>
    <t s="36">(Rosh HaShanah)</t>
    <t s="37">are drawn down through the shofar blast.</t>
    <t s="38">And this is also understood from what the Rambam wrote:</t>
    <t s="39">"Although the blowing of the shofar on Rosh HaShanah is a decree of Scripture, it contains a hint, namely: 'Awaken, etc.'" And it is explained in the discourses of our Nesi'im</t>
    <t s="40">that in the Rambam's lengthy wording, the three matters of Malchiyos, Zichronos, and Shofros are hinted at,</t>
    <t s="41">from which it is understood</t>
    <t s="42">that all these three matters are drawn down through the shofar blast,</t>
    <t s="43">and the hint</t>
    <t s="44">(the general hint)</t>
    <t s="45">in the shofar — "Awaken, etc." — is the matter of teshuvah</t>
    <t s="46">(as explained in the Rambam there),</t>
    <t s="47">meaning that the mitzvah of the shofar blast is connected to the entirety of the matter of Rosh HaShanah</t>
    <t s="48">("the mitzvah of the day is with the shofar"),</t>
    <t s="49">because on Rosh HaShanah all things return to their primordial state, and one must arouse a new drawing down from His Essence and Being,</t>
    <t s="50">and to draw this down through the entire order of the chain of descent until the physical world.</t>
    <t s="51">And this drawing down is through the shofar,</t>
    <t s="52">for the shofar alludes to the matter of teshuvah, as above, that the essence of teshuvah is unification with the Source,</t>
    <t s="53">their primordial state,</t>
    <t s="54">and it exists in a manner from below upward and from above downward, as it is written,</t>
    <t s="55">"And the spirit shall return to G-d who gave it,"</t>
    <t s="56">as explained in Likkutei Torah at the beginning of this portion</t>
    <t s="57">(the portion of Haazinu),</t>
    <t s="58">and therefore through this one arouses a new drawing down from His Essence and Being,</t>
    <t s="59">and through the deed</t>
    <t s="60">(the actual physical act of blowing the shofar)</t>
    <t s="61">one draws down</t>
    <t s="62">this [drawing down] into the physical world.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
